Always 200. A measurement we could not take is reported as ``stats_unavailable`` with
a code, never as a 5xx, so the panel degrades one section instead of failing the page.

A null measure means "not measured"; a zero means zero. ``destination_table_exists``
is separate because an aggregate over a dropped table returns 0, so the row count alone
cannot tell "empty" from "gone".

broke, this re-runs provisioning from the start. The pipe goes back to pending and
is provisioned again in the background; a delete issued mid-retry still wins.
``last_error`` stays until the retry actually starts.
